name: refresh-article
summary: Audit and update an existing long-form article with preservation, claim handling, and readiness checks.
approval_gates: vault_write: follow harness/policies/approvals.md before editing vault files unless already authorized
external_read: ask before reading external websites, sources, or current statistics
external_mutation: out of scope; CMS, repository, email, or social publishing requires a separate workflow
done_when: existing article is inspected before rewrite
preserved and changed material are distinguished
refreshed artifact or audit is returned or saved to an approved path
material claims have evidence labels or open proof flags
writing-quality-gate has passed or is explicitly deferred with reason
verification: verify article-refresh audit precedes material rewrite
verify claim-check runs when material claims are present
verify freshness metadata changes are justified
verify changed Markdown/frontmatter if files are edited
